title: Beam Search Decoding
signature: def beam_search(next_logprobs, bos, eos, beam_width, max_len) -> list
hints: Each round, expand every live beam by every token, pool all the candidates, and keep the best beam_width.
Sort with the key (-score, sequence). Python compares lists lexicographically, so ties resolve by themselves.
A kept candidate that ends in eos is finished: move it out of the beam and never expand it again. The beam can shrink.
At the end, pool the finished and the still-live hypotheses, sort them the same way, and return the first beam_width.
